Subject: Global demo — time-change coordination and new slot request

Hi Eliot —

Looking forward to the live walkthrough with the Skyline team. We have a demo slot penciled for Tuesday, 9 Nov. I want to surface one scheduling wrinkle: the US fall clock change happens on Sun 7 Nov, which will flip UTC offsets for our west-coast presenters. That shift, combined with Skyline members in Sydney and a couple in London, creates a narrow overlap window.

Proposed original slot (for reference):
- Tue 9 Nov — 10:00 AM PT / 6:00 PM GMT / 4:00 AM AEDT (next day)

That obviously pushes the Sydney attendees into the early-morning hours. To avoid an overnight session for your team, can you confirm whether an earlier Sydney-friendly time would work for you and Anna? Two alternative windows we can support (we can run from our EU region to keep latency predictable):

Option A — friendly for APAC:
- Tue 9 Nov — 6:00 PM AEDT / 7:00 AM PT / 3:00 PM GMT

Option B — middle-ground (shorter overnight for APAC):
- Tue 9 Nov — 10:00 AM AEDT / 11:00 PM PT (Mon 8 Nov) / 7:00 AM GMT

I attached a quick timezone grid and an .ics stub (updated-demo-invite.ics) so you can preview how the invite will appear in your calendars post-clock-change. If neither works, tell us the local time range that still keeps the majority of your users awake and we’ll reflow on our side — Ben can run the session from the EU cluster if that reduces latency for EU participants.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Global demo — time-change coordination and new slot request

Vanessa —

Thanks for the heads up. We’re based in Sydney (APAC team) and Nov 9 at 4:00 AM AEDT will be rough for our product folks. Our EU colleagues can be flexible in the mid-afternoon GMT window, but Anna and I would prefer something that lands in standard business hours for at least one of our offices.

Option A (6:00 PM AEDT) looks ideal for our Sydney team and still keeps London at a reasonable time. Option B still pushes a late-night / early-morning for some of our engineers. Can we lock Option A?

Also, a quick ask: could you include the meeting link that will route to your EU presenter node (we saw a 120ms variance in the last trial from APAC to US-hosted sessions)? If you can route the demo from EU, that would be perfect.

Eliot Chen
